input: 14 hand-built VCF records on chromosome 21 of the release-116 GRCh37 cache: splice donor and acceptor single-base substitutions on a forward-strand transcript and on a reverse-strand one (one lower-case), a donor site a second transcript shares, an acceptor site shared by two transcripts of opposite strands, a splice-region insertion and a donor deletion on each strand, an exonic splice-region substitution, an acceptor site whose only table row names a transcript the cache lacks, a donor site the table leaves out and an intergenic substitution

splicevault-transcript-match-0.note: Ensembl VEP's JSON output is compared under the default transcript match alone: with transcript_match=0 the plugin rewrites a cached row's event list into a hash on the first transcript row of a record it annotates (SpliceVault.pm:190) and reads it as a list again on the record's next transcript row (:183), which dies, is caught, and leaves that row without its SpliceVault object under the warning "Plugin 'SpliceVault' went wrong: Not an ARRAY reference"; vep-rs writes the object on every row the text formats annotate, so the JSON reference of this run would record the defect, and only the three text formats are compared.

generator: data/SpliceVault_data_hg19_synthetic.tsv.gz: scripts/fixtures/plugin_score_fixtures.py --shape splicevault from variants.vcf and data/splicevault_transcripts.tsv (the transcript ids rowed at each site, an id no transcript of the cache carries among them), the twelve tab-separated columns SpliceVault.pm:201 splits a line into, with fabricated events, one row per alternate base per listed transcript at every single-base site, one row per listed transcript with the anchored alleles at the insertion and deletion sites, no row at the unscored site, bgzip and tabix -s 1 -b 2 -e 2 (seed 7 and digests under plugin_fixtures); the SpliceVault file's name is the name the plugin's documentation gives (SpliceVault.pm:79), with the word `synthetic` added before the extension to say that the file is made up; json_cache: scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --gzip --drop sorted_exons --drop protein_features --drop protein_function_predictions --perl-info <cache>/info.txt --cache-version 116 over the chromosome 21 slice scripts/data/storable_to_json.pl converted from the Ensembl VEP 116 GRCh37 cache; expected outputs: scripts/concordance/generate_reference_output.sh --corpus for the manifest's run, and one Ensembl VEP 116.2 container run per format for each flag set from the vep command recorded under its flag_sets entry, the corpus mounted read-only at /work/corpus and the SpliceVault plugin read from the container's plugin directory; manifest: scripts/golden/build_golden_corpus.py select --include for every record, flag-set, then classify for the manifest's run and each flag set against the committed tree's binary
